messages:
Rae M.: quick heads-up: EdgeCloud marketplace listing + SI joint announcement readiness. Need to lock: press embargo window, landing microcopy, partner-run screenshots, demo cadence, and who owns teardown post-launch. go-live target = Fri May 17.

Diego L.: I can take screenshots + demo cadence. Will create a short script so SI can reproduce. Need staging creds and a list of models we should showcase.

Nora T.: I'll own the listing microcopy and CTA variants. Draft ready tomorrow AM. Preference for 'Try in your cloud' vs 'Request private demo'—thoughts?

Kai H.: deploy-bot: Staging env provisioned: rwd-edgecloud-stg-0517. Creds sent to Diego L. (expires 48h).

Diego L.: got creds, thanks @deploy-bot. sample model list: rw-base-v2 (low cost), rw-accelerate (latency demo), embeddings-bison (vectors). I'll script a 3-step demo.

Rae M.: press embargo: partner wants Tue 11:59PM PT release if legal ok. If partner delays quote, fallback plan = publish announcement w/o quote and follow up post.

Nora T.: leaning toward enterprise CTA for EMEA audiences and product-forward for dev docs. I'll author both copies.

Diego L.: screenshot script (example):

```
# run inference for demo recording
curl -s -X POST https://staging.redwood.com/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $STG_KEY' \
  -d '{"model":"rw-accelerate","input":"Compare LLM latency for small docs"}'
```

Rae M.: legal ask: partner legal needs to approve co-marketing assets by Thu 12:00 PT. @Nora T., please flag any partner copy that needs amends.

Nora T.: will route copy to partner ops and legal tonight.

Kai H.: dry run slots: Thu 6pm PT or Fri 8am PT. Which works for SI tech lead?

Rae M.: propose Thu 6pm PT for EU-friendly timing. I'll send invite and include runbook, slide deck, and the demo script.

Diego L.: I'll record the full demo (screen + terminal) during dry run so we have assets for the listing and blog.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: dry-run-invite sent to participants at 2023-05-15T18:00:00Z.

Rae M.: owners recap -> Listing copy: Nora T.; Screenshots + Demo: Diego L.; Staging & Infra: Kai H.; Legal & Partner Ops: Rae M. If anyone needs to swap, ping me today.

Nora T.: adding checklist to drive: https://drive.redwood.com/edgecloud-listing (private). will update CTAs and locale notes.

Diego L.: small note: SI needs sample tenant config and a minimal dataset (anonymized). Kai, can you share template?

Kai H.: sharing tenant template in drive now. Will also attach an automated teardown job to revoke creds 72h after provision.

Rae M.: perfect. last ask: press embargo fallback strategy documented in the runbook. If legal misses Thu noon, we'll slip announcement to Wed.

Nora T.: ack. I'll set a conditional publish flag in CMS and coordinate with comms.

Rae M.: thanks team — see you at dry run. :rocket:
